notes:
A350:
• Fixed: The cabin's strips and panels no longer blink between white and black: iniBuilds' cabin glow now follows the cabin light inside the aircraft's own files.
• Improved: The LED strips fade smoothly on every frame, worked out by the aircraft's models.
• New: Click a window shade to lower it a step (right click raises it, the mouse wheel moves it a little).
777:
• New: The seat screens take taps: every page, Wi-Fi, YouTube and films, as on the A350.
• New: Cabin lighting (turn it on on the 777 card): PMDG's white, blue and orange cabin lights in scenes that follow the flight, with a sunrise after the sleep.
• New: The curtains between the classes close in the cruise and open for take-off and landing.
App:
• New: Finds other cabin mods on the aircraft and offers to remove them.
• Fixed: A new version shows in the app the moment it is published.
• Fixed: An install that stopped half way no longer blocks the next one.
